remarks: 2/3 bedroom newly constructed in 2020 with high end finishes, this gorgeous townhome boasts 2 bedrooms both with ensuite baths, a bonus room previously used as 3rd bedroom on third level would make for an amazing home office space. Gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances and island seating. Open floor plan leads to light filled family and dining area and powder room. Custom cabinets, quartz counter tops, hardwood floors, 1 car garage and laundry on 2nd floor. Relax on your private front porch, near metro north train, town pool, tennis, beach, marina, park, fabulous restaurants, shopping, library and school in the heart of vibrant downtown Byram. This is a must see!
